sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.

CRL.M.C. 4522/2024 & CRL.M.A. 17038/2024 Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of chargesheet and consequential proceedings arising out of FIR No. 524/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Wazirabad.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the cause of action did not arise within the jurisdiction of Delhi and the FIR has been wrongly filed claiming the jurisdiction at Delhi.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/07/2024 at 01:25:22 Learned APP for State as well as learned counsel for respondent No. 2 submit that the chargesheet has already been filed and the revision has been preferred on behalf of two of the accused, which is pending before the Court of Sessions.

Time is also sought to refer to the relevant statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
